text: Hi, I am Ashish.
Today, 10th November,
Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2.
What can I do that has not been done before?
A true thought partner, as you write.
Writing is thinking, and if you outsource your thinking,
that's actually atrophying your thinking.
Full credit to Jason Fried.
Let me take that as the starting point, not as the end point.
Did a bunch of deep research, using again Fable 5.2.
Shout-out to Poteto, @poteto,
whose suite of skills, PStack, had a skill called unslop, which I tweaked for my personal writing.
Use LLMs to write better, and avoid losing your own voice.
Reading a bunch of stuff by David Perell,
all my free time on Substack,
all the people I admire,
ML in health and drug discovery.
Shout-out to Jasmine Sun, shout-out to Celine Nguyen.
The code is open for now,
happy to take pull requests,
brickbats and praise welcome.
Here's my attempt.
